authorship: current assistant semantic reading; program only transports authored decisions

rows.statement: Allow viewers to choose videos to watch.
rows.rationale: The described viewer role has a clear choice purpose.

rows.statement: Allow content creators to share content with the platform.
rows.rationale: The streamer role is described through its intended result.

rows.statement: Prevent viewers from seeing content unsuitable for them.
rows.rationale: A tentative but explicit requirement; suitability rules and viewer classes remain unspecified.

rows.statement: Prevent streamers from sharing prohibited content with anybody.
rows.rationale: Distinct upload-side restriction; explicit language is only an example, not an exhaustive legal rule.

rows.statement: Find a specific kind of video using text search or filters.
rows.rationale: Both are alternative ways to a single search result.

rows.statement: Browse many video options visually using thumbnails and relevant descriptions or creator information.
rows.rationale: A separately requested visual-discovery mode, not merely a text-search implementation step.

rows.statement: Upload a video to the platform.
rows.rationale: Explicit creator requirement.

rows.statement: Start a live stream.
rows.rationale: Explicit alternative creator result, separate from uploading an existing video.

rows.statement: Add descriptive information to uploaded videos.
rows.rationale: Title/description context is carried by the source and later workflow.

rows.statement: Add a transcript or captions to videos.
rows.rationale: A proposed creator capability, not an assertion of automatic perfect transcription.

rows.statement: Edit videos with operations such as sound effects, trimming and cropping.
rows.rationale: The core action is editing; examples constrain capability without inventing three compulsory separate edits.

rows.statement: Obtain meaningful search results even from vague criteria.
rows.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly wants this beyond exact search.

rows.statement: Receive a seamless buffered video stream without constant freezing.
rows.rationale: A quality result is explicit; no invented latency threshold.

rows.statement: Use video content for entertainment.
rows.rationale: Explicit purpose.

rows.statement: Use video content for education.
rows.rationale: Explicit purpose, separate from entertainment.

rows.statement: Gain needed information quickly through a search.
rows.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly summarizes this purpose; book avoidance does not prohibit reading elsewhere.

rows.statement: Avoid format incompatibility when uploading an already-made video.
rows.rationale: An inferred desired improvement from a stated potential technical obstacle; exact supported formats remain unknown.

rows.statement: Avoid restrictive video-length requirements during upload.
rows.rationale: The stated obstacle supports the concern but no numeric limit is specified.

rows.statement: Publish uploaded videos through a simple process.
rows.rationale: The questions about waiting and publication identify a desired simplification, without proving publication can precede completion.

rows.statement: Save videos to a watch list.
rows.rationale: Tentative proposed viewer capability; not compulsory usage.

rows.statement: Subscribe to creators or types of content.
rows.rationale: The suggested viewer capability is explicit.

rows.statement: Access the latest content from subscribed creators in one subscriptions area.
rows.rationale: A distinct retrieval result with subscription as a condition.

rows.statement: Make playback controls discoverable to unfamiliar viewers, including when hidden during full-screen playback.
rows.rationale: The expressed discoverability obstacle positively supports the inferred improvement.

rows.statement: Improve automatic-caption accuracy for viewers, particularly those who do not speak English as a first language.
rows.rationale: The speaker is uncertain about current accuracy; this is an inferred accessibility concern, not a verified defect.

rows.statement: Consider colour adjustments for colourblind viewers.
rows.rationale: The speaker explicitly proposes possible work while admitting not knowing current capabilities; tentative strength retained.

boundary_candidates: A guess that a large company hosts and controls content is architectural background, not an adopted deployment goal.
Thumbnails, voice-search icons, ads and interface layout are largely narrated capabilities; no distinct intention supports every UI control as a goal.
The 24-hour wait is a reported platform rule rather than a request to impose that rule.
Premium pricing and family/student plans are reported product facts, without an expressed purchase or preservation intent.
Playback toggles, timing and volume widgets are narrated options; do not automatically upgrade each to a stakeholder goal.
